pagetitle: "CHEERS 2022 checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:
  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#215e99; --head:#4c94d8; --blue:#215e99; --box:#edf4fc; --boxline:#8fbbe6; --line:#333;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.25; margin:0 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.3; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px dotted var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap th { background:var(--head); color:#fff; font-weight:bold; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap th.c { text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { color:var(--blue); font-weight:bold; padding:4px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:21%; vertical-align:top; font-style:italic; color:var(--blue); }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:5%; text-align:center; vertical-align:top; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { width:11%; padding:3px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6b86a6; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-cite { margin-top:1rem; font-size:14px; }
  /* Equator logo: hidden on screen, shown only in the saved PDF (print) */
  #tp-wrap .tp-eqrow { display:none; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { width:150px; height:auto; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #215e99; background:#215e99; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#215e99; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eqrow { display:block; text-align:right; margin-bottom:.5rem; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:17px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:10.5px; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td, #tp-wrap td.topic { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-eqrow"><img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq"></div>
  <div class="tp-title">Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards 2022 (CHEERS 2022) checklist</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the page number(s) where each item is reported in the blue boxes in the right-hand column, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Section &amp; Topic</th><th class="c">No</th><th>Item</th>
      <th class="c">Reported on page #<span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="tp-cite">From Husereau D, Drummond M, Augustovski F, et al. Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards 2022 (CHEERS 2022) Statement: Updated Reporting Guidance for Health Economic Evaluations. <em>BMJ</em> 2022; 376:e067975. doi: <a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2021-067975" target="_blank" rel="noopener">10.1136/bmj-2021-067975</a>. This checklist is distributed under a <a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CC BY 4.0</a> licence.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ["Topic", "item", "text"]; topic "" = continuation row; plain strings = section bars
  const ROWS = [
    "TITLE",
    ["Title", "1", "Identify the study as an economic evaluation and specify the interventions being compared"],
    "ABSTRACT",
    ["Abstract", "2", "Provide a structured summary that highlights context, key methods, results and alternative analyses"],
    "INTRODUCTION",
    ["Background and objectives", "3", "Give the context for the study, the study question and its practical relevance for decision making in policy or practice"],
    "METHODS",
    ["Health economic analysis plan", "4", "Indicate whether a health economic analysis plan was developed and where available"],
    ["Study population", "5", "Describe characteristics of the study population (such as age range, demographics, socioeconomic, or clinical characteristics)"],
    ["Setting and location", "6", "Provide relevant contextual information that may influence findings"],
    ["Comparators", "7", "Describe the interventions or strategies being compared and why chosen"],
    ["Perspective", "8", "State the perspective(s) adopted by the study and why chosen"],
    ["Time horizon", "9", "State the time horizon for the study and why appropriate"],
    ["Discount rate", "10", "Report the discount rate(s) and reason chosen"],
    ["Selection of outcomes", "11", "Describe what outcomes were used as the measure(s) of benefit(s) and harm(s)"],
    ["Measurement of outcomes", "12", "Describe how outcomes used to capture benefit(s) and harm(s) were measured"],
    ["Valuation of outcomes", "13", "Describe the population and methods used to measure and value outcomes"],
    ["Measurement and valuation of resources and costs", "14", "Describe how costs were valued"],
    ["Currency, price date, and conversion", "15", "Report the dates of the estimated resource quantities and unit costs, plus the currency and year of conversion"],
    ["Rationale and description of model", "16", "If modelling is used, describe in detail and why used. Report if the model is publicly available and where it can be accessed"],
    ["Analytics and assumptions", "17", "Describe any methods for analysing or statistically transforming data, any extrapolation methods, and approaches for validating any model used"],
    ["Characterizing heterogeneity", "18", "Describe any methods used for estimating how the results of the study vary for sub-groups"],
    ["Characterizing distributional effects", "19", "Describe how impacts are distributed across different individuals or adjustments made to reflect priority populations"],
    ["Characterizing uncertainty", "20", "Describe methods to characterize any sources of uncertainty in the analysis"],
    ["Approach to engagement with patients and others affected by the study", "21", "Describe any approaches to engage patients or service recipients, the general public, communities, or stakeholders (e.g., clinicians or payers) in the design of the study"],
    "RESULTS",
    ["Study parameters", "22", "Report all analytic inputs (e.g., values, ranges, references) including uncertainty or distributional assumptions"],
    ["Summary of main results", "23", "Report the mean values for the main categories of costs and outcomes of interest and summarise them in the most appropriate overall measure"],
    ["Effect of uncertainty", "24", "Describe how uncertainty about analytic judgments, inputs, or projections affect findings. Report the effect of choice of discount rate and time horizon, if applicable"],
    ["Effect of engagement with patients and others affected by the study", "25", "Report on any difference patient/service recipient, general public, community, or stakeholder involvement made to the approach or findings of the study"],
    "DISCUSSION",
    ["Study findings, limitations, generalizability, and current knowledge", "26", "Report key findings, limitations, ethical or equity considerations not captured, and how these could impact patients, policy, or practice"],
    "OTHER RELEVANT INFORMATION",
    ["Source of funding", "27", "Describe how the study was funded and any role of the funder in the identification, design, conduct, and reporting of the analysis"],
    ["Conflicts of interest", "28", "Report authors conflicts of interest according to journal or International Committee of Medical Journal Editors requirements"]
  ];
  const TITLE = "Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards 2022 (CHEERS 2022) checklist";

  const STORE = "cheers-2022-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  const linkify = t => t.replace(/\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g, (_, label, url) => {
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.setAttribute("target", "_blank"); a.setAttribute("rel", "noopener");
    a.setAttribute("data-url", url); a.textContent = label;
    return a.outerHTML;
  });
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string"
    ? `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">${r}</td></tr>`
    : `<tr><td class="topic">${r[0]}</td><td class="item">${r[1]}</td><td class="txt">${linkify(r[2])}</td>` +
      `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${r[1]}" placeholder="page no." aria-label="Page, item ${r[1]}"></td></tr>`).join("");
  tbody.querySelectorAll("a[data-url]").forEach(a => { a.href = a.getAttribute("data-url"); a.removeAttribute("data-url"); });

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "CHEERS 2022 checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all page numbers and the manuscript title?")) { fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, logo, title, eqLogo) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = [2100, 600, 6066, 1200], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const line = { style: D.BorderStyle.DOTTED, size: 4, color: "333333" };
    const borders = { top: line, bottom: line, left: line, right: line };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, italics: o.italics, color: o.color });
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? TOTAL : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnSpan: o.span,
      verticalAlign: o.top ? D.VerticalAlign.TOP : D.VerticalAlign.CENTER,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: 90, right: 90 }, borders,
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: runs(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "4C94D8", bold: true, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, "Section & Topic", hd), cell(1, "No", { ...hd, center: true }),
      cell(2, "Item", hd), cell(3, "Reported on page #", { ...hd, center: true })] });
    const body = ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string"
      ? new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r, { span: true, bold: true, color: "215E99" })] })
      : new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
          cell(0, r[0], { top: true, italics: true, color: "215E99" }), cell(1, r[1], { center: true, top: true }), cell(2, r[2]),
          cell(3, vals["p" + r[1]] || "", { center: true })] }));
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const top = [];
    if (eqLogo) top.push(para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 60 } }));
    top.push(para([new D.TextRun({ text: title, font: F, size: 24, bold: true })], { spacing: { before: 60, after: 120 } }));
    top.push(para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }));
    return new D.Document({
      title: "CHEERS 2022 checklist", creator: "CHEERS 2022 checklist",
      sections: [{
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 720, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top, new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          para(runs("From Husereau D, Drummond M, Augustovski F, et al. CHEERS 2022 Statement: Updated Reporting Guidance for Health Economic Evaluations. BMJ 2022; 376:e067975. doi: [[10.1136/bmj-2021-067975|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2021-067975]]. Distributed under a CC BY 4.0 licence.", { size: 16 }), { spacing: { before: 160 } })]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      const logo = null;
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS.map(r => typeof r === "string" ? r : [r[0], r[1], r[2].replace(/\|([^|\]]*)\]\]/, (_, u) => "|" + new URL(u, document.baseURI).href + "]]")]), vals, logo, TITLE, eqLogo));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "CHEERS-2022-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
